title: Turkish Delight Kazandibi
description: A rich and creamy Turkish dessert made with kazandibi, steamed to perfection and topped with exquisite sugar.
instructions: Combine kazandibi, milk, and vanilla extract in a saucepan over medium heat, whisking until smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the kazandibi is fully dissolved.
Remove from heat and stir in unsalted butter until melted.
Add Turkish delight and stir until smooth.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, sprinkle exquisite sugar on top.
